summary: Created an 8-phase, 4-wave plan provisioning Zotero agent tooling in this nix repo: a writeShellScriptBin 'zot' wrapper on home.packages, a single sops-sourced credential fanned out to ZOTERO_API_KEY + ZOT_API_KEY + ZOT_LIBRARY_ID across fish, bash, systemd --user, and a declaratively generated ~/.config/zot/config.toml, plus a disabled-by-default localhost-only nixpkgs zotero-translation-server. Key rotation is a decided first phase, not an open question. All verification is read-only or --dry-run; no zot write against the real library is planned.
decisions_made: Rotation DECIDED (not deferred): create a replacement key with library+files+write grants, seed secrets/secrets.yaml, revoke the old key. Phase 1, operator-gated; blocks only Phases 4-8, never Phases 2-3.
Set all three credential names from one sops secret. Report 01's ZOTERO_API_KEY-only relocation is rejected as a false-green source: zot does not read that name at all.

config.toml generated by a direct TOML write in a home.activation script (report 02 approach b), NOT by 'zot config init' (approach a) — its idempotency is undocumented and it would need a uvx network fetch inside the activation sandbox. 'zot config init' is never run against the real config path.
Translation-server uses nixpkgs#zotero-translation-server with a NODE_CONFIG host override to 127.0.0.1, replacing report 01's podman/oci-containers approach entirely.

systemd --user reach via a 'zotero-env' oneshot calling 'systemctl --user set-environment'. Both home.sessionVariables (HM #5542) and systemd.user.sessionVariables (build-time-baked, no $(cat) expansion) are explicitly rejected in the module header so a future editor does not 'simplify' it back.

sops.defaultSopsFile and sops.age.keyFile are hoisted out of discord-bot.nix's lib.mkIf cfg.enable into a new always-on modules/system/secrets.nix, so the new secret is not accidentally coupled to services.discordBot.enable.
Installer-image exposure (iso, usb-installer) from the always-on sops module is resolved by an explicit build check in Phase 4, with a documented per-host-import fallback.
Item 4 (zotero-mcp) explicitly NOT implemented; the adoption decision stays in ~/.config/nvim task 39.
Verification exercises the credential (read-only zot subcommand under 'env -i', plus a GET /keys/current grants check) rather than testing a variable for non-emptiness.
dead_ends: Relocating only ZOTERO_API_KEY into sops (report 01 Item 2) — zot does not recognize that variable, so the consuming repo's gate check would pass while zot stays uncredentialed.
home.sessionVariables for systemd --user reach — home-manager issue #5542, does not propagate.
systemd.user.sessionVariables for the secret — environment.d values are baked at build time and parsed literally; no runtime $(cat /run/secrets/...) expansion.
podman / virtualisation.oci-containers for translation-server (report 01 Item 3) — superseded by the native nixpkgs package verified buildable from the pinned nixos-26.05 cache.
uv tool install + adding ~/.local/bin to PATH — rejected, changes global PATH policy for one tool.
